# NNN: short name

- Status: open | in progress | done
- Depends on: NNN, NNN (or "none")

## Goal

One or two sentences: what exists when this ticket is done and why.

## Scope

Bullets: the concrete pieces to build or change, with file or crate paths
once known. Out-of-scope notes only when a reader would otherwise assume
otherwise.

## Acceptance criteria

Checkboxes a reviewer can verify mechanically:

- [ ] criterion
- [ ] tests: what must pass

Keep the whole file under 60 lines.
